newsitem.title: KENYA: Quality grades steady at Kenya coffee auction.
newsitem.headline: Quality grades steady at Kenya coffee auction.

text.p: Better quality Kenyan coffee fetched better prices at the weekly auction in Nairobi on Tuesday, auction officials said.
Grade ABs averaged $280 per 50-kg (110 lb) compared to $275 last week while grade AAs averaged $294 from $281. Grade PBs averaged $284 from $279.
Traders said the rush for the better grades was due to a predicted reduction in supply.
The Coffee Board of Kenya said it sold 35,400 60-kg bags on offer compared to the 45,752 bags sold last week.
